checklist_items.1.1: After the register dialog source is the HTTP directory, the dialog shows one combobox, two textboxes, one parse button, and one form extra. There is no spinbutton, no unit, no checkbox, and no alert. Source is a required combobox and its selected text is the localized HTTP directory label. Directory URL is an empty required textbox. Its placeholder is https://hf-mirror.example.com/Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B. It has no maximum length. Its form extra is the localized directory-listing sentence. Name is an empty textbox, is not marked required, has no maximum length, and its placeholder is the localized optional display name. Model directory, node, model ID, revision, and advanced options are absent. The same run rejects an empty directory URL with the directory URL error and sends no preview. The preview POST sends the typed directory URL. The register POST sends the normalized source URL, the typed model ID, and the typed name. The independent GET stores source url, those three fields, an empty revision, architecture Qwen3ForCausalLM, precision bfloat16, context length 40960, and the fixture weight, with no node copy and no storage copy.
checklist_items.1.7: The register dialog is 720 pixels wide after the HTTP directory source is selected. The minimum registration selects that source, fills only the required directory URL, parses the directory, leaves the required model ID at the preview value, and clears the optional name. That submits one POST to /api/v1/models/register-url whose body is the normalized directory URL, the preview model ID, and an empty name. The 201 response and the independent GET store the name tiny-model, source url, that model ID, an empty revision, architecture Qwen3ForCausalLM, precision bfloat16, and context length 40960. The reloaded list shows tiny-model. Opening it shows that architecture, and that detail matches the independent GET. The model is registration metadata. It does not deploy, schedule, authorize, or mount, and there is no agent and no workload.

A registration that clears the optional name and leaves the model ID at the preview value submits the normalized directory URL, that preview model ID, and an empty name. Its 201 response and independent GET store the name tiny-model, source url, that model ID, an empty revision, the same architecture, precision, context length, and fixture weight, with no node copy and no storage copy. The reloaded list shows tiny-model. Opening it shows that architecture, and that detail matches the independent GET. These models are registration metadata. They do not deploy, schedule, authorize, or mount, and there is no agent and no workload.

checklist_items.12.8: N/A: the models surface this case covers has no delete preview, no compare-and-swap and no revision-conflict check for either the reviewer or the product to act on. Revision on a model is the upstream git branch label, not a concurrency token - the form help reads 'Blank uses the platform default branch' (ui/src/i18n/locales/en/models.json:149) and the detail view renders it as a description item (ModelsPageParts.tsx:254) - and the write routes that could carry a base revision, PATCH /models/{id}/inference-config and the model edits, send no such field and answer no conflict code; errors.go has no model revision-conflict error, and the only conflict this resource defines is MODEL_IN_USE for a referenced model (internal/server/api/models.go:143), which is reference blocking for the delete item rather than a stale-write guard. The item is conditional - it applies only where the product actually offers a preview/revision/CAS - so with none offered on this surface there is nothing to observe, and teardown is not used to stand in for a delete assertion.
checklist_items.1.3: Every required text field this mode renders is checked for both an empty and a whitespace-only value, and each is refused in the browser with no request on the wire. The directory URL and the source id both declare whitespace:true, so three spaces are refused exactly like an empty value: the field is left aria-invalid, the typed value stays in place, and neither a preview nor a registration is posted. The source id rule carries no message, so its antd default wording is locale dependent and is deliberately not asserted - the contract that is asserted is the refusal and the absence of a request. Name is not a required field in this form: the minimum-create stage posts an empty name and reads back the defaulted tiny-model, so there is no empty-name refusal to claim. Proven by mutation twice - dropping whitespace:true from the directory URL rule removes the expected message, and dropping the validation guard makes a refused submit raise an uncaught page error.
